patch_notes.summary.0: Trennung der Engine-Laufzeit von Benutzerprojekten. Vollständiges RTP-Vorlagensystem und Projektgenerator nach RPG Maker MZ-Ordnerkonventionen hinzugefügt.
patch_notes.item.0.1: Erstellung von resources/template/ mit vollständiger RPG Maker MZ-Projektstruktur (data/, img/, audio/, fonts/, js/plugins/)
patch_notes.item.0.2: Projektgenerator-Modul hinzugefügt, das die RTP-Vorlage kopiert und Metadaten (Titel, Name) in System.json, package.json und Game.rpgproject einfügt
patch_notes.item.0.3: Neue native Tauri-Befehle für Ordnerauswahl, Vorlagenkopie und Projektordner-I/O
patch_notes.item.0.4: Überarbeiteter 'Neues Projekt'-Dialog mit Projektname, Spieltitel und Zielordner-Auswahl
patch_notes.item.0.5: Editor kann Projekte jetzt als Ordnerstrukturen auf dem Dateisystem öffnen und speichern
patch_notes.item.0.6: Playtest kann Projekte direkt aus einem Ordnerpfad auf dem Dateisystem laden
patch_notes.summary.1: Implemented a 32-bit tileset flags system, property painting modes in the editor, and refined palette behavior for autotiles and B-E tilesets.
patch_notes.item.1.1: Added a 32-bit flags system per tile in Assets, supporting passage (O/X/★), 4-directional passability, ladder, bush, counter, damage floor, and 8 terrain tags.
patch_notes.summary.2: The editor interface can now be used in Brazilian Portuguese.
patch_notes.summary.3: The Journal now separates abandoned quests from failed ones so players can review dropped quests independently.
patch_notes.summary.4: The in-game Journal now opens as a full-size split panel with quest browsing on the left and live details on the right.
patch_notes.summary.6: Implemented the missing grid-free editor UI in editor.js.
patch_notes.summary.7: Added a new Collision Mode to the editor for creating and editing free-form rectangular collision masks.
patch_notes.summary.8: Adapted the game engine runtime to render and process grid-free tile placements.
patch_notes.summary.9: Added a complete runtime autotile system for A1–A4 tiles.
journal.title: Journal

patch_notes.summary.11: RPGAtlas now detects, validates, and slices RPG Maker MZ tilesheets (TileA1–E.png and DLC variants) into individual 48×48 tiles, registered in a new Assets.tilesets registry with per-category metadata.
patch_notes.summary.12: Added smooth camera follow, dynamic tilt/FOV, and a PIXI-based flash overlay that integrates with the post-processing pipeline (bloom/DOF apply to the flash).
patch_notes.summary.13: Added a full 3D particle system for map/event-driven visual effects (fire, smoke, sparks, magic) in the HD-2D view, following the same event-naming pattern as point lights.
patch_notes.summary.14: Added a PIXI v8 Filter-based post-processing pipeline with bloom (bright-pass + gaussian blur) and screen-distance depth-of-field, wired to the existing map hd2d.bloom/dof flags.
patch_notes.title.15: HD-2D unified PIXI Mesh terrain renderer
patch_notes.summary.15: Replaced the separate WebGL2 terrain renderer with a pure PIXI v8 Mesh-based pipeline, removing the GPU round-trip and enabling future post-processing filters (bloom, DOF).
patch_notes.summary.16: Corrected tileset sheet dimensions to match RPG Maker MZ spec, added collision icon to editor toolbar, fixed undo/redo for collision data, and published Grid-Free Mapping plan.
patch_notes.title.17: Editor HD-2D Preview restored with PIXI
patch_notes.summary.17: Fixed the editor's live HD-2D preview panel to work with the PIXI v8 renderer instead of the removed WebGL2 gl.js.
patch_notes.summary.18: Make pixel movement active by default for new projects and preserve it during project migration.
patch_notes.title.19: Lighting polish: smoother lights, shadows disabled
patch_notes.summary.19: Improve radial light visuals and temporarily disable shadow generation while debugging.
patch_notes.summary.20: Replaced basic circle-based light rendering with a GPU-efficient radial gradient light map for PIXI v8.
patch_notes.summary.21: RPGAtlas can now be packaged as a lightweight cross-platform desktop application using the system WebView, alongside the existing local-server build.
patch_notes.summary.22: Name an event's pages and reorder, duplicate, or jump between them by drag, right-click menu, or number keys.
patch_notes.title.23: Undo, Redo & Delete-Key for Event Commands
patch_notes.summary.23: The event editor gains its own undo/redo and Delete-key shortcuts — conveniences RPG Maker never offered inside event editing.
patch_notes.summary.24: Added a persistent interface-language module so creators can use the editor chrome in English, Spanish, French, or German.
patch_notes.summary.25: Reworked the play-test movement loop so walking is fluid and runs at a consistent speed on every display.
patch_notes.summary.26: Shift+click a range of commands in the event editor and copy, cut, paste, delete, move, or drag them as one block.
patch_notes.summary.27: Copy, cut, and paste commands in the event editor — within an event or from one event to another.
patch_notes.summary.28: Reorder commands in the event editor by dragging them, not just the ↑/↓ buttons.
patch_notes.title.29: Cinematic and Control Event Command Expansion
patch_notes.summary.29: Added new visual effects commands and advanced branching controls to map events.
patch_notes.summary.30: Increased the Add Command menu from 12 to 24 buttons per page and added direct numbered page tabs.
patch_notes.summary.31: Added an easily digestible Patch Notes menu under Help so players and creators can review feature updates.
patch_notes.summary.32: Expanded Event Commands into multiple pages with 12 buttons per page and the ability to add reusable event buttons on demand.
